During the [[New Sith Wars]], a [[Zelosian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] came across a damaged '''Sith manuscript''' that mentioned the name "[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Rivan]]," a corruption of the name Revan. The Zelosian took the name [[Darth Rivan]] for himself, believing that he shared the name of the ancient Sith Lord.
